summary: Manual RPM certificate change: back up the cert and key, copy the new ones in, restorecon, chown and chmod 0600, nginx -t, reload nginx, restart automation-gateway-service; paths are /etc/tower/tower.cert (root:awx), /etc/pulp/certs/pulp_webserver.crt (root:pulp), /etc/ansible-automation-platform/eda/server.cert (root:eda) and gateway/gateway.cert (root:gateway).
questions: How do I replace AAP SSL certificates manually?
Where is the automation hub certificate on RPM installs?
What owner and permissions do the AAP certificate files need?
nginx fails after replacing the controller certificate

answer_card.title: Replace certs manually (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
cp <CERT_PATH> <CERT_PATH>-$(date +%F); cp <KEY_PATH> <KEY_PATH>-$(date +%F)
# copy new cert and key into place
restorecon -v <CERT_PATH> <KEY_PATH>
chown <OWNER>:<GROUP> <CERT_PATH> <KEY_PATH>; chmod 0600 <CERT_PATH> <KEY_PATH>
nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx.service
automation-gateway-service restart
```
Paths: controller `/etc/tower/tower.cert` (root:awx), hub `/etc/pulp/certs/pulp_webserver.crt` (root:pulp), EDA `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/eda/server.cert` (root:eda), gateway `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/gateway/gateway.cert` (root:gateway).
